title: Recording: Just A Dream by Ringo Starr | 1976
content:
Cherokee Studios, Los Angeles
Producer: Arif Mardin

Ringo Starr recorded ‘Just A Dream’ during the sessions for his fifth studio album, Ringo’s Rotogravure, on 14 June 1976.

The song was not included on the album, but was the b-side of ‘Wings’, the lead US single from Ringo The 4th in August 1977. It was also the b-side of the UK single ‘Drowning In The Sea Of Love’ in September 1977.
